user.title: Connect to HPE UXI
user.description: Use a personal API client from HPE GreenLake (Manage Workspace → Personal API clients) made for your UXI service. It only needs to read. The secret is stored only in this config entry; nothing in UXI is changed.

data_description.base_url: Leave the default unless HPE gave you another UXI API host.

error.invalid_auth: GreenLake or UXI refused this client id / secret, or the client may not read UXI sensors.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach UXI at that host.

abort.already_configured: This UXI workspace is already set up.

data_description.scan_seconds: Each check reads the status of every UXI sensor (one request per sensor). Sensors, agents, service tests and networks are read every 5 minutes.
